name: Azuma Kira
source:
Her mother is Russian. Her father is Japanese. But she's not half-Japanese. She's a child from her mother's previous marriage, so she's fully Russian. She has a timid personality and doesn't show emotions much. Her full name is Kira Alexandrovna Azuma.

[Translated from [url=http://lilys.shining-star.jp/lilys/220_Summer_Story/index.html]official site[/url]]
